title: SpiderControl SCADA Web Server
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW IMPROPER LIMITATION OF A PATHNAME TO A RESTRICTED DIRECTORY (‘PATH TRAVERSAL’) CWE-22 An attacker may be able to use a simple GET request to perform a directory traversal into system files. CVE-2017-12694 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 5.3 has been assigned; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N ). RESEARCHER Karn Ganeshen, working with Trend Micro’s Zero Day Initiative, discovered this vulnerability.
